sql_boundary.question: 2024年1月各区域已完成订单的销售额是多少？
sql_boundary.reference_sql: SELECT s.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.sale_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM stores AS s JOIN orders AS o ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-02-01' GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY s.region

sql_boundary.question: 2026年第二季度星期几的销售额最高？只返回最高的一项。
sql_boundary.reference_sql: SELECT DAYOFWEEK(o.order_date) AS weekday_number, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.sale_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY DAYOFWEEK(o.order_date) ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

sql_boundary.question: 截至2026年6月30日，从未产生过订单的门店有哪些？
sql_boundary.reference_sql: SELECT s.store_name FROM stores AS s LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.store_id = s.store_id AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' WHERE o.order_id IS NULL GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY s.store_name

sql_boundary.question: 2026年6月30日库存数量为0的门店商品有哪些？
sql_boundary.reference_sql: SELECT s.store_name, p.product_name, i.stock_qty FROM inventory AS i JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = i.store_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date = '2026-06-30' AND i.stock_qty = 0 ORDER BY s.store_name, p.product_name
